    WBSps.ca Archive Index
    The records of Ward-Beck Systems Limited, Scarborough, Ontario

    WBSps.ca  Archive  Index

    General Description:

    This archive holds the manuals, drawings, photographs and parts records of Ward-Beck broadcast equipment, sorted by model and by year. Every file was copied from the WBSps.ca collection; the originals are kept unchanged.
